translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Osirizir Akar Aghuim O Luk

content: Judas Iesus isa gumazir kurabar dafaribagh atɨ
Datɨrɨghɨn Yis Puvatɨzir Bretɨn Isam Damuamin Dughiam roghɨra izi. An ziam, God Israelia Gitazir Dughiam.
Ezɨ ofa gamir gumazir ekiaba, ko Judan Arazibagh fozir gumaziba, me gumazamizibar atiati, kamaghɨn amizɨ me Iesus mɨsoghasa tuaviba buri.

Iesusɨn 12plan suren gumazir mam Judas, an ziar mam Iskariot. Satan an navir averiamɨn ghu. Ezɨ a Iesus isava Godɨn Dɨpenimɨn garir gumazir ekiaba, ko ofa gamir gumazir ekiabar dafaribar arɨghasa ghua me koma mɨgɨrɨgɨabagh ami.
Ezɨ me an mɨgɨrɨgɨam gifuegha ivezim a danɨngasa akabar kɨri.
Ezɨ Judas ivezim inian ifuegha Iesusɨn suiragh men dafaribar arɨghasa tuaviba buri. A ghaze, Iesus uabɨra ikɨtɨ, an an suiragh men dafarim darɨgham.
Suren gumazimning daghebar kɨri
Yis Puvatɨzir Bretɨn Isam Damuamin Dughiam datɨrɨghɨn oto. Ezɨ dughiar kamɨn me God Israelia Gitazir Dughiamɨn isam bagha sipsipɨn nguzim mɨsuegh anemɨ ikɨva, a gɨnɨghnɨghasa.
Ezɨ Iesus Jon ko Pita amadagha kamaghɨn aning mɨgɨa ghaze, “Gua mangɨva, e God Israelia Gitazir Dughiamɨn isam amamin daghebar kɨr.”
Ezɨ aning an azara, “Ga managh a bagh danganim akɨram?”
Ezɨ a kamaghɨn aning mɨgei, “Gua nguibar ekiamɨn aven mangɨtɨ, gumazitam mɨner dɨpam ater izɨ gua batoghtɨma, gua an gɨn a zuir dɨpenimɨn mangɨ.
Egh dɨpenimɨn ghuavim mɨkɨm suam, ‘Tisa kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, “Nan danganir kɨ uan suren gumaziba ko God Israelia Gitazir Dughiamɨn isam amamim mana?” ’
Eghtɨ a ghuriamɨn aven danganir bar ekiatam guan akagham, dakoziba ko dapiagh damamin dabirabiba ko biziba bar ikɨtɨ, gua magh bizibar kɨr.”
Ezɨ aning ghua garima, biziba bar Iesus mɨkemezɨ moghɨrama otifi. Ezɨ aning God Israelia Gitazir Dughiam bagha dagheba ko bizibar kɨri.
Iesus bret ko wain uan aposelbagh anɨdi
Ezɨ damamin dughiam otozɨ, Iesus uan aposelba ko me dagher dakozimɨn mɨn apiaghav iti.

Egha a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Kɨ guizbangɨra ia mɨgei, kɨ ua God Israelia Gitazir Dughiamɨn isamɨn dagher katam ameghan kogh, kamaghɨra ikɨ mangɨ, God Bizibagh Ativamin Dughiamɨn otogham. Kamaghɨn amizɨma, kɨ ia ko isar kam amasa bar ifonge. Egh kɨ gɨn mɨzazim iniam.”

Egha Iesus wain apir kap inigha Ekiam mɨnabagha kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Kɨ ia mɨgei, kɨ uam wainɨn ovɨzimɨn dɨpar katam aman kogh, kamaghɨra ikɨtɨ God Bizibagh Ativamin Dughiam otogham. Kamaghɨn amizɨ, ia a inigh ia uari danɨng.”
Egha a bret inigha, Ekiam mɨnabagha anebigha me ganɨga kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Kar nan inivafɨzim, kɨ ia bagha anenɨngi. Ia anemɨ na gɨnɨghnɨgh.”
Me amegha gɨvazɨma, arazir kamra a wain apir kap inigha kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Kavɨn aven itir wainɨn kam, an Akar Dɨkɨrɨzir Gavgavir Igiam, kɨ uan ghuzimɨn a gamizɨma, a ia bagha iri.
Eghtɨ ia gan, gumazir na inighɨva gumazir kurabar dafarim darɨghamim, a kara na ko dakozim gaperaghav iti.
Eghtɨ Gumazamizibar Otarim tuavir Afeziam faragha a bagh atɨzimɨn gɨn mangam. Ezɨ gumazir a inigha gumazir kurabar dafarim gatɨzim, gumaka, a bar ikuvigham.”
Ezɨ me akar kam baregha uarira uarir azangsɨsi, “Tina bizir kam damuam?”
Iesusɨn aposelba uari adogha mɨgei, tina faragham?
Egha aposelba uari adogha ghaze, tinara en faragham?
Ezɨ Iesus kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Kantrin Igharazir Gumazamizibar atriviba, me uan gavgaviba ko ziaba fava, arazir kurabar gumazamizibagh amua kamaghɨn mɨgei ‘E gumazamizibar akurvasi.’
Ia kamaghɨn damuan markɨ. Gumazir ian torimɨn ikia ian faragha zuim, a uabɨ apengan ikɨva, borimɨn mɨn uabɨ arɨgh. Ezɨ gumazir ian faragha zuim, ian ingangarir gumazimɨn mɨn ikɨ.
Tinara ekefe, gumazir pura dagher dakozimɨn aperaghav itim o gumazir dagheba anɨdim? Gumazir pura dagher dakozimɨn aperaghav itim. Ezɨ kɨ ian torimɨn ikia mati ian ingangarir gumazim.
“Kɨ osɨmtɨziba aterima ia na ko iti.
Kamaghɨra, nan afeziam Atrivimɨn mɨn na atɨzɨma, kɨ uaghan atrivibar mɨn ia arɨghasa.
Eghtɨ nan atrivir dughiamɨn aven ia na ko atrivimɨn dabirabir aghuaribar apiaghɨva Israelian anabar 12plan ganam.”
Iesus kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, Pita akɨrim ragh a gasaragham
Egha Iesus kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Saimon, Saimon, Satan nɨn nɨghnɨzir gavgavim tuisɨgh a gɨfoghasa Godɨn azara.
Ezɨ kɨ nɨ bagha Afeziar Ekiam ko mɨkemegha gɨfa, nɨn nɨghnɨzir gavgavim irɨghan kogham. Egh nɨ uamategh na bagh izɨ, egh gavgavim uan aveghbuabar anɨng.”
Ezɨ Pita kamaghɨn a mɨgɨa ghaze, “Ekiam, kɨ nɨ ko kalabusɨn mangam o aremeghasa ifuegha iti.”
Ezɨ Iesus kamaghɨn Pitan akam ikaragha ghaze, “Kɨ nɨ mɨgei, nɨ datɨrɨghɨn dughiar pumuning ko mɨkezimɨn mɨkɨm suam, nɨ na gɨfozir puvatɨ, eghtɨ tuarim maghɨrama akam.”
Iesus ghaze, suren gumaziba uan dagɨar mɨtariba ko ruagha aruir mɨtariba ko mɨdorozir sababa ini

Egha Iesus men azara, “Kɨ dughiar kamɨn ia amadagha bizir kataba sara ia amadazir puvatɨ, dagɨaba azuir mɨtariba ko ruagha aruir mɨtariba koma dagarir asuaba. Ezɨ ia bizitamɨn otevez, o puvatɨ?” Ezɨ me kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, “Puvatɨ.”

Ezɨ a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Eghtɨ datɨrɨghɨn, gumaziba dagɨaba itir mɨtarir muziariba ikɨ da inigh, egh gumaziba ruagha aruir mɨtariba ikɨ, uaghan da inigh. Eghtɨ gumazir mɨdorozir sababa puvatɨziba, ia uan initam amadaghɨva tam givesegh.
Guizbangɨra Godɨn Akɨnafarim ghaze, ‘Gumazamiziba an gari, a mati gumazir kuram.’ Kɨ ia mɨgei, bizir kaba na bativam. Are, Afeziar Ekiamɨn Akɨnafarim osirizɨ moghɨn biziba na bativavɨra iti.”
Ezɨ me kamaghɨn a mɨgei, “Ekiam, nɨ gan. E mɨdorozir sabar pumuning kati.” Ezɨ a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “A gɨfa.”
Iesus Olivɨn Mɨghsɨamɨn God ko mɨgei
Egha Iesus nguibar ekiam, Jerusalem ategha, Olivɨn Mɨghsɨam bagha zui. A zurara ami mokɨn. Ezɨ an suren gumaziba an gɨn zui.
Me danganir kamɨn otivigha a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Ia uari bagh God ko mɨkɨm. Eghtɨ osɨmtɨzir ekiar kam ia damutɨ, ia ireghan kogham.”
Egha a me ategha, mati gumazim dagɨam akunizir tɨzimɨn ababanimɨn mɨn, mong saghon ghugha, tevimning apɨrigha kamaghɨn God ko mɨgei,
“Afeziam, nɨ ifueghava na da osɨmtɨzir kam inigh. Egh nɨ nan ifongiamɨn gɨn mangan markɨ. Nɨ uan ifongiamɨn gɨn mangɨ.”
Ezɨ ensel mam Godɨn Nguibamɨn ikegha iza gavgavim a ganɨdi.
Ezɨ Iesus nɨghnɨgha bar oseme, egha a pamtem Afeziam ko mɨgei. Ezɨ an doriba otivaghira mati ghuzim nguazim giri.
An Afeziam ko mɨkemegha, dɨkavighava uamategha uan suren gumaziba bagha zui. Egha a men garima, me bar osemegha akuavɨra iti.
Ezɨ a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Ia tizim bagha akui? Ia dɨkavighɨva Afeziam ko mɨkɨm. Eghtɨ osɨmtɨzir ekiam ia damutɨ, ia ireghan kogham.”
Judas Iesus isava, gumazir kurabar dafarim gatɨ
Egha Iesus mɨgɨavɨra itima maburan gumazir bɨzim oto. An 12plan suren gumazir mam Judas, a men faragha iza tuavim men aka. A Iesusɨn boroghɨra izegha an torasava ami.
Ezɨ Iesus kamaghɨn an azara, “Judas, kar nɨ Gumazamizibar Otarimɨn toreghɨva, a inigh gumazir kurabar dafarim darɨghasa?”
Ezɨ suren gumaziba Iesus ko ikia garima arazim otivasava amima, me kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Ekiam, e uan mɨdorozir sababar me mɨsogham o?”
Ezɨ men mav mɨdorozir sabam inigha, ofa gamir gumazibar ekiamɨn ingangarir gumazir mam mɨsogha, bar an kuarim anetuzɨ a irɨ.
Ezɨ Iesus kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Arazir kam atakigh!” Egha Iesus an kuarimɨn suirazɨ, a ua dera.

Ezɨ ofa gamir gumazibar ekiaba, ko Godɨn Dɨpenimɨn garir gumazir ekiaba, ko Judabar gumazir aruaba, me iza Iesusɨn suighasava amima, a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Ia mɨdorozir sababa ko asianiba inigha iza mati, ia okɨmakɨar gumazim o mɨdorozir gumazim buri?
Kɨ zurara ia ko Godɨn Dɨpenimɨn aven itima, ia dafarim na garɨzir puvatɨ. Ezɨ datɨrɨghɨn ian dughiam. Datɨrɨghɨn mɨtarmemɨn gavgavim oto.”
Pita ghaze, a Iesus gɨfozir puvatɨ
Ezɨ Iesusɨn apaniba an suigha a inigha ofa gamir gumazibar dapanimɨn dɨpenimɨn zui. Ezɨ Pita men gɨn ghua mong gɨrara iti.
Ezɨ me dɨpenimɨn dɨvazimɨn aven avim atɨgha apiaghav itima, Pita uaghan me koma aperaghav iti.
Ezɨ ingangarir guivir mam avir angazangarimɨn an garima, a me koma aperaghav iti, ezɨ a mɨghɨgha an garava kamaghɨn a mɨgei, “Gumazir kam a ko ike.”
Ezɨ Pita kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, “Puvatɨ! Amizim, kɨ a gɨfozir puvatɨ.”
A mong ikezɨma, mav ua gɨn iza an apigha kamaghɨn a mɨgɨa ghaze, “Nɨ uaghan men mav.” Ezɨ Pita kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Ai! Kɨ an suren gumazim puvatɨ!”
Dughiam mong ghugha gɨvazɨma, gumazir igharazim izava pamtem ghaze, “Guizbangɨra kav, a Galilin gumazimra. Kamaghɨn e guizbangɨra fo, a uaghan a ko ike.”
Ezɨ Pita kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, “Aiee! Nɨ tizim mɨgei? Kɨ bar fozir puvatɨ!” Egha a mɨgɨavɨra itima, tuarim ake.
Ezɨ Ekiam raghɨrɨgha mɨghɨgha Pitan garima, a mɨkemezir akabagh inɨrɨ, “Nɨ datɨrɨghɨn dughiar pumuning ko mɨkezimɨn mɨkɨm suam, Nɨ na gɨfozir puvatɨ, eghtɨ tuarim maghɨrama akegham.”
Egha Pita inɨrɨghava, azenan ghugha bar puvɨrama azi.
Me Iesus mɨsoghava a dɨpofi
Ezɨ gumazir Iesusɨn suighiziba dɨbovir akabar a mɨgɨava a mɨsosi.
Egha me inir avɨzimɨn an damazimning ikegha kamaghɨn a mɨgei, “Godɨn akam inigha izir gumazim, nɨ e mɨkɨm! Tina nɨ mɨsoke?”
Egha me akar kurar avɨrir maba saram a mɨkeme.
Iesus gumazir apanibar damazimɨn tughav iti
Ezɨ amɨnim tirazɨma, Judan kotɨn aven itir gumazir aruaba (ofa gamir gumazir ekiaba, ko Judan Arazibagh fozir gumaziba) me bar iza uari akuvaghav itima, me Iesus inigha men damazimɨn zui.
Ezɨ me kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Nɨ e mɨkɨm, kar nɨ Krais, God Uam E Iniasa Mɨsevezir Gumazim, o ti puvatɨ?” Ezɨ a kamaghɨn me mɨgɨa ghaze, “Kɨ ia mɨkemeghtɨma, ia nɨghnɨzir gavgavim nan ikian kogham.
Eghtɨ kɨ ian azaraghtɨma, ia na mɨkemeghan kogham.
Eghtɨ datɨrɨghɨn ko gɨn izamin dughiaba, Gumazamizibar Otarim gavgaviba bar itir Godɨn agharir guvimɨn daperaghɨv ikiam.”
Ezɨ me bar an azara, “Kar nɨ Godɨn Otarim?” Ezɨ a me mɨgɨa ghaze, “Ia guizbangɨra mɨgei, kɨ an Otarimra.”
Egha me kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze, “E tizim bagh uamategh gumaziba inightɨ me gumazir kamɨn arazibar gun e mɨkɨmam? A uabɨ bizir kam mɨkemezɨma, e an akatorim baregha gɨfa.”
